blocks.text: Testing program ko jaanchne ka amal hai taake yaqeeni ho ke woh sahi chalta hai aur tawaqqo wala output deta hai.
Debugging program ki ghaltiyan ya bugs dhoondne aur theek karne ka amal hai.
Bug program mein ghalti ya kharabi hai jis se program ghalat nateeja deta hai ya ajeeb rawayya dikhata hai.
Programming error code ki ghalti hai jo program ko sahi chalne se rok sakti hai. Aam ghaltiyan: syntax errors, logic errors aur runtime errors.
Unit testing aisa tareeqa hai jis mein program ke chhote hisse, jaise akele functions, alag alag test kiye jate hain ke sahi kaam karte hain ya nahi.
Test case inputs, tawaqqo wale outputs aur sharait (conditions) ka majmua hai jis se dekha jata hai ke program ya function theek chal raha hai.
unittest Python ka built-in module hai jis se program ki durusti check karne ke test cases banaye aur chalaye jate hain.
pytest Python ka testing framework hai jis se saade aur taqatwar test cases likhe aur chalaye jate hain.
Breakpoint program mein woh jagah hai jahan program ruk jata hai taake programmer variables ki values check kare aur program ka rawayya samjhe.
Watch expression debugging mein istemal hota hai taake program qadam ba qadam chalte waqt kisi variable ya expression ki value par nazar rakhi ja sake.
Exception handling runtime errors sambhalne ka tareeqa hai taake program chalte chalte achanak band na ho.
Profiling program ki performance napne ka amal hai taake pata chale ke code ke kaun se hisse zyada waqt ya wasail lete hain.
Optimization code ko behtar banane ka amal hai taake woh tez chale, kam wasail le, ya zyada achhi karkardagi dikhaye.
Performance bottleneck program ka woh hissa hai jo poore program ko sust karta aur karkardagi kam karta hai.

items: Ghaltiyan dhoondein: tests (unittest, pytest) aur debugging tools (breakpoints, watches, stepping).
Crash se bachein: try, except, finally.
Tez karein: profile karein, bottleneck dhoondein, optimise karein, dobara napein.
